name: Schema validation

on:
  pull_request:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 3 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

      - name: Run schema validation
        run: |
          echo "TODO: replace with real validation command (e.g., make validate or pytest)"
          exit 0

# Governance Runbooks

This repository contains operational runbooks and lightweight governance processes for the Northwind Labs data platform.

## Contents
- Incident / issue handling
- Data contract change process
- Access requests and approvals
- Release and rollback checklists

## Contribution rules
- All changes require review by CODEOWNERS.
- Keep runbooks actionable and tested during incidents.

# Default owners for everything in this repository
* @northwind-labs/platform

# Documentation and runbooks
/docs/ @northwind-labs/platform
/runbooks/ @northwind-labs/platform

# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately.

- Email: security@northwind.labs
- Please include: impacted component/schema, reproduction steps, and any logs/screenshots that help.

We will acknowledge receipt within **2 business days** and will provide status updates until remediation is complete.

## Supported Versions

This repository follows a rolling support model.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| default branch | supported |
| older branches/tags | not supported |
